name: ahmed-mods
description: Mods for Claude Code: live bands and panes inside the terminal, desktop and VS Code

plugins.name: cache-status
plugins.description: Prompt-cache countdown, hit-rate bar and turn cost above the prompt

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Stops Claude from writing API keys, private keys and other secrets into your files

plugins.name: done-chime
plugins.description: Chime and toast when a long Claude reply finishes

plugins.name: agent-chat
plugins.description: A side pane with the messages between Claude and its subagents: each task handed over and each report sent back
